observation: Fresh-main inspection found RunStore.get() rejects a persisted North Star run unless cycle is an integer >= 1, and RunStore.create() always emits cycle: 1, while the checked-in North Star Run v0.2 schema defines cycle but does not require it. The published contract therefore admits a document the real runtime rejects.
changes: Require cycle in the checked-in North Star Run v0.2 schema without changing its existing integer minimum of 1.
Extend the existing contract/runtime parity regression to prove the schema-required cycle invariant matches RunStore.get().
